limitations: Windows x64 Juna adapter only; cross-terminal equivalence is not yet established.

Input timing is posted A key -> unique colour observed through window capture plus local coordination I/O/polling; not physical keyboard/display latency. Child receipt is timestamped before output with the same-machine performance counter; cross-process ordering uncertainty is one tick. Only deltas are exported.
Fresh isolated settings: IBM Plex Mono 16, Catppuccin Mocha, Git bar disabled; default window dimensions and host DPI. Keep desktop/GPU/power settings fixed. No private path/transcript/pixel export.

One warm-up excluded. Executable hashing warms file cache. Startup ends at synthetic child ready, not first paint. Memory is parent-process only; excludes capture helper, shell and GPU. Region categories are not allocation call-stack attribution.

Output bytes are producer bytes, not a byte-exact ConPTY transport counter. Final marker proves final response observed, not every intermediate frame. Trials include coordination overhead; small-sample p95 is exploratory.
True Ctrl+C response, scroll latency, multiple tabs, battery/power and PresentMon/WPR comparisons remain unmeasured.
